facts.value: ASU requires students to complete three different lab sciences.
To determine if your lab sciences meet the requirement, ASU may need additional information.
If additional information is required, a Priority Task called Course Description will be displayed on My ASU.
High school can submit lab sciences to the courseapproval.asu.edu website for ASU review.
Submit a course description form for each lab science taken in an accredited online high school environment to ASU’s homeschool representative if not already approved.
Meet one of the following: Two years of the same high school second language.
Attainment of a minimum score on a national standardized second language test or placement into a third semester college second language class based on university placement exam results.
Two transferable 3- or 4-credit, college-level courses in the same second language.
